sources.title: Qwen: Qwen3.5-9B - AI Model Details & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B, a multimodal foundation model from qwen, demonstrates a strong overall reliability with an 83% success rate across benchmarks, indicating consistent operational stability. However, its speed performance is a notable area for improvement, ranking in the 10th percentile, suggesting longer response times compared to peers.

sources.title: qwen/qwen3.5-9b • LM Studio
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 represents a significant leap forward, integrating breakthroughs in multimodal learning, architectural efficiency, reinforcement learning scale, and global accessibility. This is a 9B parameter dense model, supporting a native context length of 262,144 tokens.

sources.snippet: The following are the only mandatory parameters to send in the HTTP POST request to v1/chat/completions. model (string): Model ID used to generate the response, in this case since only a single model is deployed within the same endpoint you can either set it to Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B or leave it blank instead. messages (array): A list of messages comprising the conversation so far.
